items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: He had, uh, Ed Atkins. Ed Atkins was, yeah. On trombone that one. Yeah, on trombone. I was playing guitar.

ctx.x: And you remember who else was in the band with Oliver when you worked with him and where

you played? Uh, let's see now. We played so many different, we was playing spot job. We didn't have no sound plays until we went to Hunson Nagel. Now, uh, let's see. What color was this, Hunson Nagel? He had, uh, Liberty in the Outerville. Liberty. He's band, he had, uh, uh, Call it the Casino. Oh yeah. He had, uh, Chris Kelly. Uh, no, uh, he had, uh, uh, Chris Miner on the drum. And he had, uh, uh, Alphonse Piku. And, uh, Joe Atkins. Uh, Joe Atkins. Uh. Joe Atkins. Uh. Joe Atkins. Ed Atkins. Ed Atkins was, yeah.…
That was the Magnolia band. Do you remember, uh, I think, uh, Louie Kepard tells me that he played in the Magnolia band too with Oliver for a while.
